messages:
sam-docs: quick heads-up — i'm landing a docs PR that bundles a few private/vpc/onprem fixes: minimal nftables + iptables examples for the installer, a Windows conn-checker example, and a short HSM PKCS#11 cert-rotation note. tagging reviewers: @kevin-ops for network bits, @jon-ml for HSM flow, @maria-engineering for the sdk/snippet. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4523 :wave:

kevin-ops: will take a look today. main ask: make the port matrix explicit (tcp/udp + source ranges) and show an example for SNAT rules in both nft and iptables. also add a one-liner for troubleshooting MTU-related hangs.

maria-engineering: i have a windows nodejs sdk snippet that uses the http_proxy env var — will paste below. want it in the quickstart and the conn-checker section.

maria-engineering: ```
// windows example (powershell)
$env:HTTPS_PROXY = "http://proxy.example.local:3128"
node -e "const r = require('@redwood/inference'); r.Client({apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY}).text.create({model:'x-v1', input:'hi'}).then(console.log)"
```

jon-ml: regarding HSM rotation: we should call out the two common pitfalls: (1) incorrect pkcs11 module path (differs across distros & packaged HSMs), (2) forgetting to update the runtime user permission on the device file after rotation. i added a short step-by-step and an example pkcs11 config snippet in the PR.

jon-ml: sample pkcs11 entry to include: ```
module: /usr/local/lib/your-hsm-pkcs11.so
slot: 0
user_pin_env: HSM_PIN
```

kevin-ops: nftables snippet looks good, but can you also show the equivalent iptables-save / iptables-restore pair so ops folks can paste?

sam-docs: yes — added both iptables and nft examples in the network appendix. small note: i kept the iptables example as an atomic save/restore pair instead of in-place iptables rules to avoid mid-change packet loss.

docs-lint-bot: link-check FAILED: markdown link "installer/conn-checker#windows" -> 404. rule: internal-link-target.

sam-docs: thanks bot — @maria-engineering can you update the anchor on the conn-checker section to include the windows subsection and re-run?

maria-engineering: done — pushed a tiny edit that adds the `windows-conn-check` anchor and fixed a stray code fence that the linter complained about. pushed to the same branch.

docs-lint-bot: re-run complete. link-check OK. markdown-style: OK. spell-check: 1 warning (mtu vs MTU casing).

kevin-ops: quick content suggestion — add a note under the SNAT example that cloud NAT gateway behavior may differ if customer uses provider-managed NAT. keeps expectations clear.

sam-docs: added a short callout and CI snippet that warns about provider NAT. also added the MTU casing fix.

jon-ml: small nit: pkcs11 example should mention `CKR_USER_NOT_LOGGED_IN` as a failure mode and a pointer to the HSM vendor doc. added a one-line note in the PR.

maria-engineering: i updated the sdk snippet to include a proxy + timeout example for the windows quickstart. also added a short troubleshooting bullet for TLS cert chain issues when using internal CAs.

sam-docs: looks good — i'm merging after tests pass. leaving one final TODO: add a tiny migration note for customers moving from PKCS#11 file-based modules to HSM daemon (we'll link to the separate migration guide).

sam-docs: merge complete (commit 7a1c9f3). thanks everyone :tada: if any followups, open a separate small PR for the migration guide link so we can iterate without touching the installer doc further.
